summary: Osisko Gold Group Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an executed indenture dated September 30, 2026 for $600,000,000 of 9.250% senior secured notes due 2031, with Computershare serving as US trustee, Canadian trustee and collateral agent, alongside a same-day press release. The notes are guaranteed by named guarantors and collateralized, establishing a new secured debt layer ahead of unsecured obligations. No equity, voting, or change-of-control terms are stated; this is a routine financing, not a special situation. Watch covenant incurrence limits, collateral coverage and refinancing risk given the 9.25% coupon.
